question: Can one averse to the Lord's knowledge still be included among those serving the Śāmbhava vow?
premises: A person may be averse to the Lord's knowledge.
The same person may serve the Śāmbhava vow.
Both conditions are presented together concessively.
inference: Even one averse to the Lord's knowledge may be a servant of the Śāmbhava vow.
uncertainties: This verse is syntactically incomplete on its own and continues into the following verse.
plain_english: Even of one who is averse to my knowledge, yet serves the Śāmbhava vow...
